hooks.description: kmctl: print the knowledge briefing (where knowledge lives, what is due, the rules). Never blocks.
hooks.command: command -v kmctl >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo '[kmctl] kmctl is not installed, so there is no knowledge briefing. Install it with: uv tool install git+https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl'; exit 0; }; kmctl briefing || echo '[kmctl] kmctl briefing failed; run kmctl briefing in a terminal to see why, or upgrade with uv tool install --force git+https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl.'; exit 0

hooks.description: kmctl: after a tool call, when a concept in .okf/ changed after .okf/summary.md, ask to update it or run kmctl summary ack. Never blocks.
hooks.command: command -v kmctl >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo '{}'; exit 0; }; KMCTL_PINNED=1 kmctl summary nudge --format claude 2>/dev/null || echo '{}'; exit 0
